parts.name: Dashboard launcher
parts.purpose: Finds the repository, checks its architecture file and starts the local dashboard.

parts.name: Local dashboard API
parts.purpose: Serves graph queries, source views and live updates to the dashboard.

parts.name: Repository indexing
parts.purpose: Discovers source files, resolves references and updates the index as files change.

parts.name: TypeScript source analysis
parts.purpose: Extracts symbols, imports and calls from TypeScript syntax trees.

parts.name: Graph and revision storage
parts.purpose: Persists graph evidence, source snapshots and revision history in SQLite.

parts.name: Shared graph contracts
parts.purpose: Defines the data exchanged between indexing, storage and dashboard views.

parts.name: Code exploration workspace
parts.purpose: Lets users navigate the repository, inspect source and review recent changes.

parts.name: Architecture mapping
parts.purpose: Groups indexed files into parts and shows their connections and recent changes.

parts.name: Feature and behaviour tracing
parts.purpose: Discovers features and traces their behaviour from interface code through services to data access.
